rationale: The discourse has become highly quantified and procedurally aligned, but the core dispute remains unresolved: management/investors still insist on possible closures and deeper structural cuts, while labour/state/family continue to reject closures and compulsory redundancies absent proof. The last two rounds mostly reiterated positions and requested the same plant-by-plant savings model, so the exchange is circling around an evidence gap rather than moving toward convergence.
